searchText: Found a small TODO in eip7928 spec.py — MAX_CODE_SIZE is hardcoded to 24 KiB but Amsterdam (EIP-7954) is 64 KiB. Constant isn’t used yet. Worth a cleanup PR, or should I add a BAL + max code size test instead? Thanks for raising. I'm cleaning up this file as of yesterday and saw this too. A EIP-7954 max code test is a BAL + max code test for Amsterdam so I think we are good. If you see any missing coverage a PR is always welcome though! Got it, thanks Felipe! I’ll leave spec.py to you then. Thanks for flagging 👌🏽
